Author: kaldigo
Name: Accord
Description: Configures the compatible Wrathful Combo engine through its settings API and manages static/live hotbars. Includes compact PvE/PvP layouts, three-bar manual logout fallback with login restoration, and automatic Sprint conversion on active hotbars. Development preview.
Punchline: Reviewed intent settings and matching hotbars.
Changelog: Validated source update. Development preview; native acceptance remains separate.

Author: kaldigo
Name: Aetherworks
Description: Teleport home while Return is on cooldown, with optional fare confirmation. Sync shared hotbars between PvE and PvP: initially copy PvE, then synchronize changes in either direction. Each feature is independently enabled.
Punchline: Paid Return fallback and shared PvE/PvP hotbar sync.
Changelog: 0.2.1: Add Shared Hotbar Sync as the second feature. Initially copy shared PvE hotbar assignments into PvP, then sync edits and clears in both directions with per-character history, mode-appropriate Sprint, conflict choices and local backups. Include shared cross hotbars. Pause during combat/loading and on failed writes or unreadable history. Keep Return via Teleport and its optional confirmation-skip setting in the Pandora-style feature browser. All former Aetherworks features and the KamiToolKit dependency remain removed. Native in-game acceptance remains pending.

Author: NightmareXIV, kawaii
Name: AutoRetainer
Description: Collect and assign ventures to your retainers from the comfort of your bed.
Punchline: Collect and assign ventures to your retainers from the comfort of your bed.
Changelog: Initial Steward integration preview. Collection references, exclusions, sale rules, live policy gates, retainer withdrawals, market listing/repricing and dresser actions. AutoRetainer identity and existing workflows are preserved. Starts in dry run. Native game acceptance remains pending.

Author: kaldigo; based on MidoriKami's ExpandedHotbars
Name: ExpandedHotbars Plus
Description: Create hotbars of any size, spacing, and keybinds, with functions to show and hide these bars dynamically.
Punchline: Add and control an unlimited number of custom additional hotbars.
Changelog: Validated fork update from source e3ab7c877b2b2a1b59b30a9593734bf9f18c8b74. Build, configuration, merge-policy and package checks passed. Preserves the fork's auto-close and icon customizations. Development preview; native UI acceptance testing remains separate.

Author: kaldigo
Name: Steward
Description: Collection-aware inventory decisions and market rules coordinated with the AutoRetainer integration fork. Starts in dry-run mode.
Punchline: Collect what matters. Sell the surplus.
Changelog: Blue-rarity collection protection now applies only to nonmarketable equipment. Marketable blues can still be protected by glamour references, curated lists and the other existing rules. Missing prices do not make an item nonmarketable. Native game acceptance remains pending.

Author: kaldigo; based on Team Wrath's Wrath Combo
Name: Wrath Combo
Description: Wrath rotation engine fork with configurable continuation, targeting and support functionality. Configured independently or through its settings API. Accord-compatible build. Replaces stock Wrath Combo; remove the legacy WrathFork installation before loading.
Punchline: Configurable Wrath rotation engine and settings API.
Changelog: Validated source update. Development preview; native acceptance remains separate.
